notes.title: Account Security Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]We have stopped resetting passwords for now and have placed the forum in Read Only mode. 
You will still be able to register an account and change your details but you will not be able to post onto the forum.[/b][/h1]
[b]If you have received a password reset from the forum. You will need to reset your password to play the game. [/b]

Due to a recent spam wave on the forum, we are tightening security when it comes to user accounts on our platform (the forum which acts as the user authentication for in game).[/b]
[u][b]Our system has not been compromised![/b][/u] These accounts are sharing passwords with other services that have been and this is now allowing bots to login to this forum to spam.
We will still be banning all the accounts that have spammed the forum plus any that are associated with them.


We originally planned to just ban all accounts without a Discord or Steam connection but have found many of the spamming accounts to have linked one of these accounts and to also be active game players.

Further investigation has shown that the user accounts on the forum that have been compromised are using shared passwords with other services that have leaked their passwords.
To combat this, we will require all users to reset their passwords.


We still advise adding Steam or Discord to your account for added security but we will now not be banning forum accounts (not game accounts) without these 3rd party accounts attached to their forum account. This might change at a later date.

You will receive in the next few days an email from the forum asking you to change your password.
If you have never confirmed your email, now is the time to check that it is correct. You will not be able to login to update your email once we send out password resets!

If you have used a temp email to signup, you must change this now to a real one.
We do not send out emails other than account related ones so there will never be spam from us!

Failure to change your password will result in you being locked out of your game account! Please act now to check your email is correct on the forum.
https://community.projecttorque.racing/account/

notes.title: Community update and more content to come.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, RX here. It's been a while since I've spoken at length about what goes on behind the scenes, so today I'd like to take a moment and do exactly that with all of you.

I'm very aware of the fact that things have been slow regarding the game, and this is what I want to discuss with all of you. Things have been much quieter than normal, and that's for good reason. Something that is important to remember is that Project Torque is a privately-run venture managed by a group of volunteers with preexisting obligations and/or day jobs, meaning time available to many of us is limited. However, that is not to say that things have been at a standstill behind the scenes. On the contrary, we have quite a few projects in the background that we all look forward to putting in the hands of our community. Projects like these require time and effort from everyone on the team as each of us has our own skill sets and access to unique tools, and thus getting the stars to align is difficult. We hope to do something about this when we can, but we can't give any sort of ETA and for that I apologize.

For now, I'd like to give a huge thanks to the community as a whole, and in particular I'd like to shout out 3 people: 

 Deus Iratus, who has done a great job of picking up the GS role in my absence.
 
 Facepalm, who has been such a huge help internally that it allowed us to have the ability to work on vehicles at all.
 
 SmokeRider, whose community events and endeavors have helped keep the competitive side of the community together and has our support internally.
 
With all that said, we've decided to give you a sneak peek at some of the things we've been working on. While we can't give any release dates yet, we can say that we're spending our available time and resources polishing up what we have here so that it's the best it can be when the time comes and we look forward to seeing what you all think of them. Until then, we'll see you on the streets!

-RX

notes.title: Build 5020 - New hangar, update to Nurgenhoch and oh yea 20 lap races.
notes.notes:
[h3]Build 5020 is here with quite a few changes.[/h3]

First of all, we are streaming most of the development of the game on my Twitch. Be sure to follow so you can watch and get involved. More people there, the more voices we hear when changing stuff in game. So help shape the future and join in. [url=https://www.twitch.tv/jackster1337]Twitch.TV/Jackster1337[/url]

[h3]Hangar upgrade[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35321584/e0ba8fe701813450fdfae3ce5a6bc45ca8ce1610.jpg[/img]
Hangar has been upgraded to the Heat Online release. This features slightly improved graphics compared to the original as well as many more tracks including those outside of the main hangar building. There are now 9 tracks in Vs and 3 for drift.


[h3]Nurgenhoch update[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35321584/63ff612ef5aa975d331daa446eb1199c537ac942.jpg[/img]
Nurgenhoch has had most of its art assets added (a few missing still). This fixes a few texture issues as well as adds a few more advertising boards into the game. 
Most of the ad boards are disabled but hot air balloons, tent stands and small bear can balloons are back.
This also fixes the firetruck position on the track so no more firetruck sticking out of the barrier on the first corner.
You will also notice the overhead distance markers for corners making it easier to known when to brake. 

[h3]Lap count update[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35321584/d1d2a91055c891a183c764e03096d5c0259c5504.jpg[/img]
One of the most requested items to fix in the game was lap counts. Originally lap count was based of the level lock of the track. The higher the level of the track, the more laps you could do.
This is obviously not great for lower level players but also a single lap in some maps is not worth doing due to then the downtime between matches.
With update 5020, all players can now start races with up to 20 laps. This is up from the maximum of 7 for higher level maps.
Event lobbies can now host up to 100 laps too so this should make events more interesting. 

We are evaluating this change over the next week or so. Seeing how it effects the game. Do note that finish times should be longer to accommodate slower players. So actual downtime between races for some might be on par with 1-2 lap races.

Feedback is welcome in the discussion forum. Link below.

notes.title: Build 5016 update & community news
notes.notes:
Hello gamers!

[b]2x XP and RP for the next 24 hours is now live![/b]


Build 5016 has just been uploaded to Steam and will be required to update to from today.

[b]Arcade Vs Braking[/b]
As many of you have seen and complained about, playing with a keyboard in Arcade Vs results in instant braking.
This has been fixed and you can expect braking in Arcade Vs to be a little more realistic.
This means you wont be able to go so fast into a tight bend anymore or brake very fast to prevent crashing into a wall.
So keep this in mind when racing from now on.

We will be also releasing build 5017 early next week which applies the same fix (and a few other adjustments) to CTF and maybe slight adjustments to other game modes.

[b]Thunder Alley player count.[/b]
We have for a long time believed that Thunder Alley "could" support more than 20 players. 
The other day we found out how to increase the player count in all game modes (the code is hard to work with), have have successfully tested a few of the maps with increased player count in Thunder Alley.
Starting positions are still bugged. This use to be okay back in the day, we are unsure what changed as we don't have access to archives of builds from the early days. 
But we hope to fix this at a later date.
Expect a lot of crashing in the first lap of 32 player TA...


We are still working on Steam Auth and hope to have a working developer build soon. This will drastically improve the experience for new users, many of which have had issue signing up over the past few weeks due to the forum bugging out. 

We are also still looking into the startup issue and connection issue. We have not been able to replicate these issues our end yet so it is quite hard to get detailed analysis of the issue.
Using a VPN does help with the connection issues to Login Server and Game Servers though.


[b]Community update[/b]
This week we created a Community Manager role which will take over all community management from GM-Jack so he (me) can focus on game management, development and support. 
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/racerxnfs/]RacerXNFS[/url] has been playing PT for many years, is very experienced in racing games (it is all he plays) and has experience with community management. Over the next few weeks he will be fully taking over community management and bringing on board more GameSages to help moderate the game and Discord.

[b]We are not looking for applications to become a GS (or a GM). Do not send them, we ignore all requests. [/b]


That's it for now. More updates to come. 
Hopefully see some new cars in a week or two.
Follow me on Twitch for live developer streams where we test out new features, cars and maps. 
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/jackster1337]https://www.twitch.tv/jackster1337[/url]

Have fun and see you on the track.
Jack

notes.title: 20th December Release Date!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35321584/10e0c6204194470ca2359a8f66d85a9b8404db5d.jpg[/img]

It has been a busy few months here at Project Torque HQ. With the help of several people we have finally passed Steam verification and have a release date set for the 20th of December.
If we can release a few days earlier, we will.

It has taken quite a bit of work to get to this stage, and we know you all have been waiting a long time to get the full game released on Steam.

We would like to thank everyone who played during the open and closed beta. Your valuable feedback on the game, economy and physics has been noted and hopefully we can fix all the issues you have brought up.

Backers of the crowdfund should receive keys that will gift them their rewards. We will be giving out GP and Boosters, with other rewards being made available when they are available.

Please do go add the game to your Steam wish list. You will get notified when we release the game.

notes.title: New forum and Contract signing!
notes.notes:
Before I go into detail about contract. We have set up a dedicated forum for the community. It is 100x better than Steam forum so go use it. You login with Steam so it is not like you are having to sign up for something.

https://community.projecttorque.racing/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35321584/58466ee54197f6e41ab44d4709328819da538569.png[/img]


[b]We will be signing the contract tomorrow between us (the publisher) and Invictus Games (the owner and developer of PT).
[/b]
Invictus has asked me to make it clear that the game code from their point of view is "considered to be unmaintainable" in terms of development and that "any further development based on the existing codebase as a high-risk financial operation".
The agreement between us and Invictus does state that they will deliver a working game but there will probably be some bugs. 

I don't believe this will stop us working on the game and I have every intention on improving the game once we get going, even if it is slow, costs money, etc. 
All of our revenue share will be put back into the game to make it better. 

If you would like a refund, now is your last chance. 
Reply to the invoice email to obtain a refund. Refunding your pledge will remove you from the backers list, early access beta and all rewards. 
Refunds will need to be requested before 13:00 28/08/19 UTC

notes.title: Crowdfund is live!
notes.notes:
Months of working on deals, building the community and getting our Steam and Discord store pages ready have come down to the final hurdle. 

Today we launch our crowdfunding campaign on our website!

You can back the project and get varying levels GP and XP/RP boosters in return as well as exclusive cars, car paints and more.
Oh and early access.

In total, we need to raise $10,000 for the publishing rights to the game. 
(we are already 20% the way there)
This includes source code so we can improve the game and hopefully integrate into Steam and Discord with open ID.

We will also be working on improving the graphics and general performance on modern gaming systems. 
In the future, if the game does well we would like to add new features such as new game modes including Rally and Competitive. 

But we can only do this with your support.
Please back our crowdfunding campaign today. The sooner we raise the full amount the faster you get to play the game again!

Thank you all for adding the game to your wish list. 
Don't forget to check out our Facebook and Discord too!
